# FullCalendar 7.1.1

Locally hosted official standard global bundle and Monarch theme. No CDN request is made by the app.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fullcalendar@7.1.1/

- `all/global.min.js` → `fullcalendar.js`
- `themes/monarch/global.min.js` → `monarch.js`
- `skeleton.css` → `skeleton.css`
- `themes/monarch/theme.css` → `theme.css`
- `themes/monarch/palettes/purple.css` → `palette.css` (workspace overrides palette tokens)
- `LICENSE.md` → `LICENSE.md`

License: MIT. Installation reference: https://fullcalendar.io/docs/vanilla-js
